description: Check generation job status. Completed results may include labeled native ImageContent previews; use them directly and never Markdown-embed result URLs. They are display previews, not originals: url/download_url are originals, preview_url is the fallback link, and poster_url/thumbnail_url is a video poster. Returns compact status, parent/child generation IDs, camera, avatar_id, model_id, model_slug, use_case, net credits_charged, credits_refunded, estimated_processing_seconds, and status_guidance. Failed jobs also return a safe error_message and error_type (user, transient, or provider). Set include_snapshot=true to recover full settings, resource snapshots and prior prompts. Status can remain Created while queued/preparing; avoid tight polling loops. UI 'Gemini Pro' maps to model_slug nano-banana-pro or nano_banana_pro_clothing.

inputSchema.description: Input schema for checking generation status.

generation_id.description: The generation ID to check. Returns compact status, avatar_id, model_id, model_slug, and use_case. UI 'Gemini Pro' maps to model_slug nano-banana-pro or nano_banana_pro_clothing.

include_snapshot.description: Include full generation settings, resource snapshots and raw prompt payloads. Large; use only for prompt recovery.

name: get_generation_status
